      • setRuntimeTypeDetection

        public void setRuntimeTypeDetection(boolean enable)
        Enables/Disables runtime type detection. Set this true, if the exact type of a inexact Object should be detected at runtime. This feature allows to cast a Object to its exact type.

        Example:
        EditorCommand command = EditorCommandFactory.create(EditorAction.NEW, InvoiceEditor.META.tableDesc(), "", "");
        InvoiceEditor invoice = (InvoiceEditor) getContext().openEditor(command);
        invoice.setSwd("someswd");
        invoice.abort();

        Disable this feature if you want to use AJO without generated schema class files.
        Parameters:
        enable - true/false enables/disables runtime type detection

      • getRuntimeTypeDetection

        public boolean getRuntimeTypeDetection()
        Returns:
        Returns true if runtime type detection is enabled. Defaults to true.
        See Also:
        setRuntimeTypeDetection(boolean)
